One Rule, don't be an idiot. pretty simple. Have some etiquette. If you don't, it is really easy to get banned.

- English only. No spoilers, backseating, or asking to switch games. Zero self-promotion, stream plugs, or promo raids. Respect mods and each other. Hate speech, slurs, and harassment will not be tolerated. Follow Twitch ToS.
- 1. racism and sexism of any kind are strictly prohibited
- 3. no harassments or any inappropriate remarks
- 6. links and promotion unrelated to the stream is not allowed (ask mods for permission!)
- 7. trolling in moderation welcome :) but don't let it become toxic/negative and ruined the vibe of the stream
- 8. please use English as the main language :)
english only in the chat please.
Breaking either rule leads to permanent bans without warning.
